mapper.insert: INSERT INTO introduction (workspace_id, introducer_user_id, person_a_id, person_b_id, status, note, introduced_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{introducerUserId}, #{personAId}, #{personBId}, 'made', #{note}, #{introducedAt}) AS ni ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'made', introducer_user_id = ni.introducer_user_id, note = ni.note, introduced_at = ni.introduced_at

INSERT INTO introduction (workspace_id, introducer_user_id, person_a_id, person_b_id, status, introduced_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{introducerUserId}, #{personAId}, #{personBId}, 'dismissed', #{introducedAt}) AS ni ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(introduction.status = 'made', introduction.status, 'dismissed')
mapper.sql: SELECT i.id AS id, i.person_a_id AS person_a_id, pa.name AS person_a_name, ca.name AS person_a_company, pa.image_url AS person_a_image_url, i.person_b_id AS person_b_id, pb.name AS person_b_name, cb.name AS person_b_company, pb.image_url AS person_b_image_url, i.introducer_user_id AS introducer_id, u.display_name AS introducer_name, i.note AS note, i.introduced_at AS introduced_at FROM introduction i JOIN person pa ON pa.id = i.person_a_id JOIN person pb ON pb.id = i.person_b_id LEFT JOIN company ca ON ca.id = pa.company_id LEFT JOIN company cb ON cb.id = pb.company_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = i.introducer_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM introduction WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'made'

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, p.company_id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, p.image_url AS image_url FROM person p LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id = p.id) )
SELECT person_id AS person_id, company_id AS company_id, company_name AS company_name FROM person_employment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT person_a_id AS person_a_id, person_b_id AS person_b_id FROM introduction WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
